title: Context-aware rolling-window calibration packs with hybrid temporal-reservoir sampling
text:
Context-aware rolling-window calibration packs with hybrid temporal-reservoir sampling

description:
Goal: produce per-domain calibration packs optimized for FP8 and INT8 quantization workflows that balance recency, context-length distribution, and representativeness of rare cohorts. Deliver a reproducible curation pipeline that emits fixed-size packs per domain (configurable budget) plus holdout slices for accuracy validation and regression detection. The approach blends a rolling-time-window to capture recent drift, stratified context-length buckets to preserve sequence-length distribution, and a hybrid reservoir sampling algorithm where entry probability decays with age but preserves exemplars for low-frequency cohorts. Additional requirements: PII scrubbing pass, on-the-fly near-duplicate deduplication, and metadata tags to preserve KV-cache continuity (conversation IDs, prompt-position anchors).

acceptance_criteria:
Pipeline produces N=10k packs per domain with reproducible seeds
Per-domain packs maintain context-length distribution within ±5% of production traffic
Calibration packs reduce mean token-level KL between float32 and FP8 quantized model to < 0.025 on holdout
End-to-end PII scrubbed artifacts and audit log for each pack generation
Automated validation job that fails CI if semantic accuracy delta > 2% relative to baseline on holdout

validation_metrics:
token_KL_float_vs_quant < 0.025
perplexity_delta < 3%
semantic_similarity_F1_holdout >= 0.92
pass_rate_regression_checks >= 0.995
latency_overhead_for_pack_generation < 1.5x baseline

comments:
2025-02-15 Kickoff: scoped design doc and required infra (storage + tagging). Agreed on per-domain budget of 10k examples by default; can be overridden for high-traffic domains.
2025-02-20 Prototype: implemented rolling-window extractor and stratified bucketizer. Early results: naive time-window overweights short contexts; added context-length stratification.
2025-02-25 Design feedback from PM/Research: add temporal decay to reservoir sampling and ensure deterministic seed flow for reproducibility across runs. Action: introduce epoch-seed derivation tied to release tag.
2025-03-01 Engineering review: PR #5123 opened for sampling library and KV metadata preservation. Request from review: include conversation-anchor heuristic to avoid chopping cached spans. Assigned follow-up to Liam.
2025-03-04 Validation run #3: generated calibration packs for 12 domains; FP8 calibration on small model reduced token-level KL from 0.041 to 0.019 on holdout. Noted higher error for 'billing-support' domain — investigating sampling weight for low-frequency intents.
